in_marathi.name: सतोष
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Contentment, Joy, Delight
in_marathi.long_meaning: सतोष हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name सतोष is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘सत्’ which means ‘truth, being’ and ‘तोष’ which means ‘contentment, joy, delight’. In Hindu mythology, the name is associated with Lord Shiva and represents the state of being content and at peace with oneself and the universe.
